Common Questions

Helpful answers before you schedule.

Do you install both 5-inch and 6-inch gutters?

Yes. The right size depends on roof area, runoff, the existing drainage setup and the look of the home.

Can damaged gutters be repaired instead of replaced?

Often, yes. Leaks, loose sections, pitch issues and individual damaged components may be repairable. If the system is failing in several areas, replacement may make more sense.

Do you work on soffit and fascia too?

Yes. Soffit and fascia are separate services and can be especially important when the roof edge needs repair before new gutters are installed.

What areas do you serve?

Our core service areas include Hickory, Boone, Statesville, Lincolnton, West Jefferson, Lenoir and Denver, along with nearby communities.

How do I get an estimate?

Use the Free Estimate button anywhere on the site or call or text 828-302-8609.
